Thank you for your appeal! I really admire how you capture character personality in your artwork.

Here is the story of Princess Rei:

Act I: Her kingdom is conquered and she is taken captive by a warlord. She is shown in jewels and silks, but abused in private.
Act II: She uses her beauty and cunning to exploit the Warlord’s paranoia. He is destroyed, and Rei takes the throne.
Act III: As queen she rules through fear, like her captor. After being confronted by her father and trusted ally, she breaks down and finds her humanity again. At its heart, this is a story about trauma.

Outfit – purple halter, slit skirt, tilted crown, many jewels

Choose any version or story act of her. Overall composition is up to you. Her duality: always radiant on the outside, but her expression can shift—sometimes proud, sometimes broken, sometimes sly, sometimes cold. Show both allure and tension beneath.

I look forward to it, thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zocnmYJnCWFQMAT9GE0OSog5BfHKu1mr
